name: What is the average cost per square foot for ground-up construction in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost per square foot for ground-up construction in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost per square foot for ground-up construction in Orange County varies widely depending on factors like material choices, architectural complexity, quality of finishes, and specific site conditions. On average, you might expect costs to range from $300 to $600 per square foot for a custom home. This figure can be higher for luxury finishes or unique designs. It's important to get a detailed quote tailored to your specific plans rather than relying solely on averages, as these can omit significant variables such as landscaping or premium features.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ground-up construction in Orange County typically ranges from $300-$600 per square foot, varying by materials and design.
